question: Trace the centerlines of the walls on this floor plan.
convention: A wall centerline runs midway between its two drawn faces, along the length of the wall. Trace structural and partition walls only. Do not trace furniture, fixtures, casework, doors, windows, stairs, grid lines, dimension strings, leaders, hatching, room tags, or title-block linework. Trace each wall once, no matter how many rooms it separates. Start and end a segment where the wall run ends or where it meets another wall. Put a vertex at every corner, jog, and junction. Keep the centerline continuous through door and window openings. Do not merge collinear runs across junctions.
notes: TLE hard task; recovered from vendor page annotations (geojson_walls/centerline); expected 447, recovered 453 (approximate)
